test_title: PYST 6:SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On:17 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter - cluster in the same way as the second letter - cluster is related to the first letter - cluster and the fourth letter - cluster is related to the third letter - cluster.

RJN : OLU :: DHL : MJG :: VKC : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Increasing number series is added to the position values according to English alphabetic series diagonally.

So,

 
• RJN : OLU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/008a41828c70c04e4f2601a1a9cae8069ebc7be0f92a946b95d193e8290fef39.png] 

And,

 
• DHL : MJG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cbacfef7fbf70a013160dc114b8ff28744328425ea01f0466edacc17aee7494.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• VKC : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a0ffc6977905bdf1177fe39547e636386ea0d18a95fb5fef3cf22e911ff4ab9b.png] 

​Hence, "**DMY**" is the correct answer.

81
